nora: @here quick status  model-catalog index service returned 503s for model-list and model-search endpoints starting 2026-12-02T02:01Z. Impacted hosted API clients that request model metadata; some SDK calls returned errors. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2412345678

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-981 created  severity: medium  services: model-catalog, hosted-api  start: 2026-12-02T02:01:10Z

jasper: tl;dr: indexer eviction job overwhelmed the catalog DB with bulk deletes during compaction; DB connection pool hit maxclients -> 503s from catalog API -> hosted-api received errors when hitting model-list endpoints.

rina: timeline: 01:58 compaction/eviction job kicked off in eu-central -> 02:01 elevated DB wait time observed -> 02:03 catalog API started returning 503s -> 02:06 rate-limiters throttled back client traffic and we triggered degraded mode to serve cached catalog entries.

ops: mitigations applied: 1) paused eviction job at 02:04 2) raised DB connection limit for catalog-read replicas temporarily 3) enabled serving from CDN cache and a short TTL fallback for model-list responses. Error rates dropped by 02:09.

jasper: commands/queries we ran: ```psql -h catalog-db-replica -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='catalog'"``` and ```kubectl -n catalog logs -l app=model-indexer --since=30m | grep compaction```  indexer showed bursty delete batches.

infra-bot: Automated alert: pg_stat_activity > 250 for catalog-db-primary at 02:02:45Z  threshold breached.

support: customer notice posted at 02:12 UTC. Affected surface: model listing/search; generation requests that reference model ids were unaffected. Draft: "We experienced transient errors when listing models between ~02:01-02:09 UTC due to an internal indexing operation. Cached listings were served and most clients were unaffected; if you see persistent failures please contact support."

rina: follow-ups: 1) add backoff to eviction job 2) shard deletion batches by tenant to avoid compaction storms 3) add preflight DB connection gating for heavy indexer jobs.

ops: next steps: run a background consistency check to ensure no missing model metadata: `python tools/catalog_verify.py --since 2026-12-02T01:50Z` and keep CDN fallback for 1h. Postmortem scheduled for 2026-12-03T14:00Z.

incident-bot: Current status: mitigated  monitoring  link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2412345678  postmortem: scheduled

nora: thanks team. Please add logs and queries to the postmortem doc and tag data-infra. If anyone sees residual 503s reopen this thread. :mag:
